subject: Kickoff: Buyflow milestones & mutual action schedule for ClearWave GCP commit
messages:
From: Sam Patel <s.patel@clearwave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Buyflow milestones for GCP commitment

Aditya —

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. We want to lock down a concrete buyflow so our internal stakeholders (procurement, legal, finance) can sign off. High level: ClearWave is targeting a committed GCP private offer (6-12 month reserve) to support inference in production.

Can you share a mutual action schedule that includes: technical acceptance criteria (eval pass/fail), procurement checkpoints (PO, legal redlines), billing/invoice flow for Marketplace/GCP billing, and an expected close target (we're trying for EOY 2026 but open to Q1 if needed). I attached our initial SOW requirements for reference.

CCing procurement mailbox — please add any operational constraints.

Next step: can we get a draft MAP and a brief 30-min alignment this week?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearWave AI

Attachment: ClearWave-SOW_REQS.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <s.patel@clearwave.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Buyflow milestones for GCP commitment

Sam — thanks, this is clear and helpful. I put together a first-pass mutual action schedule attached (RW_MAP_ClearWave_v1.docx) and a short checklist below. Happy to iterate in the call.

Proposed MAP highlights (draft):
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks sandbox (perf + acceptance tests) — target: completion by 2026-09-28
- Technical acceptance: % of p95 latency and throughput targets (we'll include explicit test cases in the MAP)
- Procurement milestones: PO request -> legal redlines -> signed commitment (target by 2026-10-01)
- Billing path: GCP Marketplace private offer; invoice run to ClearWave Finance via GCP billing (we recommend invoice-to-email + consolidated monthly invoice)
- Finance ask: net-30 terms (we can support net-45 if required, but need to lock before commit)
- Onboarding: enablement + production validation window (1 week)

Please review the attached; I also added a DocLink for a live MAP so we can co-edit: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-MAP-draft

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min alignment call — Wed 2026-09-15 10:00 PT (I sent a calendar invite)
2) ClearWave runs eval tests (we'll provide test harness and checklist)
3) Procurement submits PO draft to procurement@clearwave.ai

Happy to adjust dates once we hear back from procurement/legal.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: RW_MAP_ClearWave_v1.docx (docx, 42 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP v1 — billing + procurement notes for ClearWave

Aditya / Chloe — quick ops notes on the draft MAP. I reviewed RW_MAP_ClearWave_v1 and have a couple of recommendations to make the billing transition smoother on GCP marketplace:

- Recommend we add a single-line summary of the marketplace invoice flow (GCP bills ClearWave directly; Redwood receives settlement from GCP). Add a contact point at GCP billing if finance wants dispute support.
- For private offer activation we need: marketplace entity ID, billing contact, and PO number. Collect these fields in the MAP early.
- Flag for finance: if they want Redwood invoice directly (instead of GCP settlement) we need a Marketplace reseller agreement; that usually adds 5 business days to invoicing steps.
- Suggest aiming for signed commitment by 2026-10-04 to allow finance to process net-30 before first invoice run.

Questions for the call: can ClearWave accept consolidated monthly invoices vs per-transaction? Also, confirm net terms (30 vs 45). If ClearWave wants net-60 we should surface to leadership.

Leaving a short checklist I will track in the MAP:
- Marketplace entity ID received
- Proc contact sheet populated (procurement@clearwave.ai)
- Legal confirms standard PO language (I can share a template)
- Billing path confirmed (GCP direct vs Redwood invoicing)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: procurement-contact-sheet.csv (csv, 2 KB)

From: Sam Patel <s.patel@clearwave.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Buyflow milestones for GCP commitment

Aditya / Marissa — appreciate the fast turnaround. MAP v1 looks good overall. A few quick items from procurement/legal: 

- Legal asked that SOC2 evidence and our internal security checklist be referenced in the MAP; here's a link to our questionnaire: https://clearwave.ai/security/questionnaire
- Procurement confirms they can populate the marketplace entity ID by EOD Friday (procurement@clearwave.ai)
- Billing: ClearWave prefers consolidated monthly invoices and net-30. Please include a paragraph in the MAP that describes the expected invoice cadence and point of contact for disputes.

We are aligned on the proposed dates — target sign by 2026-10-01. If Redwood needs additional approvals for net-30 we can flex to 45 but prefer 30.

Next: I reviewed the DocLink and added comments. I'll mark acceptance when you push an updated MAP that includes the SOC2 reference and billing paragraph.

Thanks — see you on the Wed alignment call.

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | ClearWave AI
procurement@clearwave.ai
